notes.title: Update #1 - Issues With Controllers Fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is the very first update of [b]the Valley of Super Flowers game[/b]. First of all, thank you very much for supporting this game! It has been a great learning experience for me.

I have been receiving complaints regarding some generic PS4 controllers not working correctly in-game. So, I have updated the build fixing the issues. 

[b]Features added/ Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[b]
1. XBOX Controller Control issues are now fixed.
2. Generic GamePad issues are now fixed. 
3. Some minor changes in-game.
4. Better character controls when using gamepad.[/b]

If you encounter any issues while playing this game please let me know as soon as possible. I will take a look and push a new update fixing them.

Thank you so much for taking your time to play this game! I hope you will enjoy it. More updates will be available in the future. So, stay tuned!

Best Regards,
Anamik
